verdict.rationale: A password manager with a CLI for scripts and CI/CD could plausibly offer a sandbox or test environment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented sandbox, test-mode, or isolated non-production environment. Using separate vaults (e.g., personal vs. work) would only be a user-side workaround, not a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
